items.quote: Peers observed that Veel Wilell drove the talent pipeline for the branch for the whole division.
Direct reports said that Veel drove reaching a deal with the contractor after weeks of back-and-forth for the whole division.
Several respondents noted that Veel set the direction for dashboards tracking service performance metrics across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Veel Wilell championed adoption of new technology tools for case officers and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Veel was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of customer feedback improvements at service centres.
Direct reports said that Veel took ownership of drafting legislative amendments for the new act and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Veel championed the organisational restructuring of the department and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Veel Wilell headed cross-agency collaboration on the joint taskforce, setting priorities for several teams.
Direct reports said that Veel headed cost savings across procurement, setting priorities for several teams.
